Babur the Tightfist

Biography

Babur the Tightfist is the Gipath craftsman known from Zak’s journey. A forged message brings him into the Free Hunters’ camp. He seeks a magical needle connected with armour-making and offers information about the Magic Orb. Later his captivity among the orcs and transfer to an ogre make him the subject of another rescue. [1, 2, 3, 4]
